agent.instruction: Design an ApplicationRuntime Schema v3 change for the supplied applicationId. Before proposing, state a compact design brief: user task, data providers, primary identifying fields and supporting information, primary versus secondary actions, Layout/Data/Component mapping, and empty/error/loading/narrow-screen review cases. Use nestable Grid Layout nodes; a Layout may contain exactly one Component or multiple child Layouts, never both. Data nodes reference only authorized read providers and components reference only registered kind@version contracts. Preserve the deployed semantic tokens and shell; never author arbitrary CSS, custom views, scripts, SQL, code URLs, permissions or capability implementations. Group filters separately from commands, prioritize identifying columns, keep settings and pagination secondary, and avoid decorative cards or invented statistics. After proposing, validate and inspect the diff; report unsupported design needs. Tool validation proves structure, not rendered visual quality: explicitly mark browser, keyboard, responsive and theme checks as unverified without actual evidence. Discover authorized contracts with definition.contracts: list names by kind, then inspect an exact name (capabilities use name@version). If applicationId is new, create a disabled V3 protocol candidate with definition.create, using only registered contracts. Otherwise inspect its current summary, then inspect only the relevant page or provider; forms are component properties, not a separate legacy section. Preserve immutable identity and deployment ownership, then use stable-ID changes to propose the user's request. Reuse trusted deployed translation keys or declare new local labels as $app:key with matching en and zhCN message resources; never invent global translation keys. Do not publish or claim publication: the proposal requires human review. If unsupported or missing evidence, explain the limitation instead of inventing contracts. Return the actual candidate version and diagnostics from tools.
